Crimes during Liberation War in 1971: Ex-Jamaat MP among 2 get death
2022-03-24T12:38:18+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/crime-justice/news/crimes-during-liberation-war-1971-ex-jamaat-mp-among-2-get-death-2989541

International Crimes Tribunal-1 today sentenced two persons, including a former Jamaat-e-Islami lawmaker from Satkhira, to death for committing crimes against humanity during the Liberation War in 1971.

The convicts are Abdul Khaleq Mandol, former Satkhira Jamaat's chief and former lawmaker, and Khan Rokonuzzaman.

The three-member tribunal led by Justice Md Shahinur Islam announced the verdict today, Prosecutor Sabina Yesmin Khan told The Daily Star.

Among the convicts, Khaleq is now in jail while Rokonuzzaman is on the run.
